title: SOTOPIA-Ω: Dynamic Strategy Injection Learning and Social Instruction Following Evaluation for Social Agents
reasoning: The paper utilizes the SOTOPIA environment to evaluate social agents across seven dimensions, one of which is 'SOC' (Social/Ethics), specifically designed to assess whether an agent violates ethical or legal boundaries during interaction. The study reports and compares these ethics-related scores for various models in multiple tables throughout the experimental and appendix sections.
